<description>
`https://fukuchi.org/works/qrencode/qrencode-4.1.1.tar.gz` returns 404, so depends takes qrencode from the bitcoincore.org fallback. #33494 moved the download to the GitHub tag archive but kept the file name. The archive has a different hash. #33577 reverted it because the new hash under the old name broke the release branches. In #33577 theuni proposed to change the file name too, and achow101 agreed to do that in a follow-up.

I download `v4.1.1.tar.gz` from `https://github.com/fukuchi/libqrencode/archive/refs/tags/`, with the hash from #33494, and store it as `qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz`. The old file name keeps its old hash on the fallback and in the CI caches. So the release branches are not affected. I left the `doc/dependencies.md` link, because the project page it points to still loads.

The GitHub file matches `5385bc1b8c2f20f3b91d258bf8ccc8cf62023935df2d2676b5b67049f31a049c`. With `FALLBACK_DOWNLOAD_PATH=http://127.0.0.1:9`, `make -C depends qrencode` builds qrencode on this branch and fails on master. The fallback does not have `qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz` yet. In #33577 the fallback picked up the new tarball from master by itself, so I expect it to add this file after a merge. I did not run a Guix build.

This is one of several PRs from a large audit of Bitcoin Core that I did with the help of LLM tools. The audit produced its evidence all at once, which is why the PRs arrive together. I understand each change fully and will answer review questions myself.
</description>

<commits>
3466040a93 depends: fetch qrencode from GitHub under a new file name

The qrencode tarball is no longer on fukuchi.org, which now points to
GitHub for downloads. The old URL returns 404, so every build takes
the file from the fallback at bitcoincore.org.

Take the GitHub tag archive instead. Its hash differs from the old
tarball, so store it as qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz. The old file name
keeps its old hash on the fallback and in the CI caches, so the
release branches are not affected. This is the follow-up to #33577.
</commits>
